datasets.name: ods_kreditxml
datasets.sql:
select rownum,f.name filial,b.name,b.boorowerid
,
case when c.cust_type=0 then (select(select name from customers where id=custid2)  from customers_relations where custid=c.id and work_post=2)/*mudur idisi*/end mudr,
case when c.cust_type=0 then (select(select name from customers where id=custid2)  from customers_relations where custid=c.id and work_post=3)/*tesisci idisi*/end tesici,
'Bir-biri il? ?laq?li borcalanlar uzr? qrup kodu',
case when(select  prinad from customers_relations where custid2=p.boorowerid  )>0 then 'he' else 'Yox' end  tip,'?m?liyyat?n xarakteri',
p.dateofconclusion,p.dateofconclusion,p.duedatelastcontract,(select count(*)from cm_prolongations where id=p.id)uzadilmasayi,v.val_name,p.annualyinterestrate,
p.creditlineamount,h.rest, h.obligation,h.duerest,h.interestrest+h.dueinterestrest cemfaiz ,h.interestrest,h.dueinterestrest,h.penaltyrest,
cm_utils.Get_creditPlanPrincipal(p.id,sbop.get_date),cm_utils.Get_creditPlaninterest(p.id,sbop.get_date),
(select  max(paydate) from cm_payments   where creditid=p.id) opdtarix,
 (select sum(payedamt+payedintamt+payeddueamt+payeddueintamt+payedpenaltyamt )pay from cm_payments  where 
  paydate =(select max(paydate)from cm_payments where creditid=p.id) and creditid=p.id) odmeb,h.dueday,h.dueday,e1.percent,h.reserverest, e2.percent,h.reserveintrest,
  case when  (select count(*) from cm_prolongations where tranceid is not null and creditid=p.id)=0 then 'Yox' else 'He' end as res,
  (select max(prolongdate) from cm_prolongations where tranceid is not null and creditid=p.id)resdat,
  (select count(*) from cm_prolongations where tranceid is not null and creditid=p.id)ressay,(select name from cust_quality where id=c.quality_id)kefiyyet
  , case when g.pledgeid=3 then g.pledgeprice else 0 end as g1, case when g.pledgeid=25 then g.pledgeprice else 0 end as g2
  , case when g.pledgeid=6 then g.pledgeprice else 0 end as g3 , case when g.pledgeid=4 then g.pledgeprice else 0 end as g4   
  , case when g.pledgeid=5 then g.pledgeprice else 0 end as g5, case when g.pledgeid=2 then g.pledgeprice else 0 end as g6  ,g.pledgeprice,pg.description,t.description,ca.description,p.purposeofcredit
 from cm_active_credits p,filial f,cm_boorowerinfo b,customers c,avalute_t v,cm_curr_state h,
 cm_reserve_types e1,cm_reserve_types e2,cm_guarantee g,cm_pledges pg,cm_credittypes t,cm_categories ca

where p.branchid=f.id and
p.id=b.creditid and
p.id=g.creditid(+) and
 pg.id=g.pledgeid and
c.id=p.boorowerid and
p.currency=v.valute and
p.id=h.creditid and
h.reserveid=e1.id and
h.duereserveid=e2.id and 
t.id=p.credittype and
ca.id=p.customertype and   p.dateofconclusion between :dat1 and :dat2  and p.id in(65766,46515,66514,59319,34477)
